goal: Turn a local video or audio file into a markdown transcript
preconditions: A browser with WebAssembly; the file is on the device; no account needed.
main_flow: 1. Visitor chooses or drops a file. 2. App reads it locally and extracts the audio track. 3. App loads the speech model (from cache when present). 4. App transcribes in 30 s chunks, showing progress and partial text. 5. App assembles markdown and shows it with copy and download actions.
errors: Unsupported codec → fallback decoder; out of memory → actionable error; model download failure → retry message

goal: Transcribe in a specific language instead of auto-detection
main_flow: Visitor picks a language before starting; the value is passed to the transcriber and printed in the markdown header.

goal: Decide whether the transcript carries timestamps
main_flow: Visitor toggles the option; timestamps are emitted per chunk when enabled.

goal: Copy the transcript to the clipboard
main_flow: Visitor presses Copy; the markdown text is written to the clipboard and the control confirms.
errors: Clipboard permission denied → message pointing at Download

goal: Save the transcript as a .md file
main_flow: Visitor presses Download; the browser saves <source-name>.md.

goal: Recover from a failed decode or a failed run
preconditions: A run failed or the file is in an unsupported container.
main_flow: App explains what failed; the visitor can retry or drop a different file. The fallback decoder is attempted automatically for container-level failures.
errors: Fallback decoder unavailable → message naming the accepted formats

goal: Clear the result and process another file
preconditions: A transcript or an error is on screen.
main_flow: Visitor presses Start over; the form resets and the model stays loaded for the next run.
